scope: Bounded descriptive assessment only; union of original preregistered disjoint cells, no exclusions or reruns

terminal_mac_qualification.sampling_scope: Native sampling on arm64 only; formal receipt independently reports Rosetta qualification.

native_tree_differences.reuse_rule: Source-compatible Linux/Mac/Rust/assessment claims bound to 637 may be carried to b9 through this recorded four-file review while retaining their actual tested source, binary/input hashes and limitations. Do not relabel a 637 receipt as exact-b9 execution.
native_tree_differences.windows_exclusion: The changed Windows launcher requires its real source-bound retest. Source compatibility alone does not establish a passing Windows qualification or a qualified complete distribution.
